items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow (no fracture on X-rays), was carted off and ruled out; HC Dan Quinn said he will miss time. Last similar injury cost him about a month.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow reinjury; additional testing Monday; historical multi-week absence.
items.implication: Commanders offense without dual-threat QB; backup streamer needed; ROS downgrade significant if multi-week.
items.opportunity: Reduced designed runs and scramble upside for WAS skill players short-term.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered a hamstring injury, was carted off emotional and not putting weight on the leg; imaging scheduled Monday. Postgame walking with slight limp but severity TBD; cautious outlook likely.
items.why: Hamstring injury mid-scramble; carted; Monday imaging.
items.implication: Potential multi-week absence; Bears may turn to backup; mobility-dependent fantasy value at risk.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps and possible scheme shift to more pocket/pass for CHI WRs/TEs.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially ACTIVE; will wear flak jacket. Pre-game optimism from reports confirmed.
items.why: Cracked rib but cleared; RapSheet bullish tone earlier.
items.implication: Start with docks possible but volume expected; reverse prior beneficiary stashes if any.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full routes/targets if limited only by pain tolerance.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip/groin) is a true game-time decision for MNF; missed practices, Schefter notes trending wrong direction / more likely out. Beneficiaries include TEs and depth WRs like Mumpfield if both Nacua and Whittington miss.
items.why: Hip/groin; multiple DNPs; conflicting but pessimistic late reports.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; if out, run-heavier or TE/WR2 bump for LAR.
items.opportunity: If out: elevated routes for Davante Adams, TEs, Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) will have MRI today; hope it is minor as he played through it. Was Q to return in-game.
items.why: Stinger; played through but MRI pending.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 3; possible limited or rest if more than minor.
items.opportunity: If limited/out: Gainwell or committee bump.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers (knee): “Close, very close. He looks great.” Missed Week 2 (doubtful) but targeting near-term return, possibly Week 3.
items.why: Post-meniscus trim progress; coach very positive after limited practice/warmups.
items.implication: Elite TE1 stash/activate soon; Mayer loses primary role on return.
items.opportunity: High-end TE usage upon activation in Kubiak offense.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive. Berry urges grabbing Jonah Coleman now as the clear look/beneficiary.
items.why: Hamstring; not expected pregame and confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup elevation for DEN backfield volume.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for next man (Coleman per analysts).

items.text: Levitan projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks (Rap bullish); Puka true GTD; Chris Olave clean/no docks and fine; Harvey opens Jonah Coleman look; Pittman opens Germie Bernard look. Weather accounted in projections.
items.why: Injury report parsing + RapSheet tone + practice/reports; docks only where warranted.
items.implication: Start McConkey/Olave with confidence adjusted; stash Coleman/Bernard; pivot for Puka.
items.opportunity: Clean Olave usage; McConkey volume despite rib; backfield/WR depth elevation on outs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is OUT. Opens opportunity for secondary WRs; Rapoport noted need for big game from Bateman.
items.implication: Target share redistribution in BAL; Bateman/others elevate.

items.text: Colts WR Michael Pittman (foot) is OUT. Levitan and Berry flag Germie Bernard as stash/look for YAC and McCarthy fit.
items.implication: IND WR depth chart shift; slot/YAC options rise.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Colts WRs.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by HC Kyle Shanahan; could have returned in Q4 if needed. Demarcus Robinson has high ankle sprain.
items.implication: Likely available Week 3 with minimal docks; Robinson more concerning for depth.

items.text: Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba: 9/155/3 TDs; now fifth WR ever with 8+ catches, 120+ yards, TD in each of first two team games. Historic early usage/role confirmation.
items.why: Elite production and volume through two games.
items.implication: Locked WR1/elite weekly play; ROS confidence high.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target/route share in SEA offense.

items.text: Joe Burrow (back) and Chris Olave (hamstring) both ACTIVE/expected and played; ETR/Levitan had them clean expected with no real docks for Olave.
items.why: Expected to play reports confirmed active.
items.implication: Full or near-full CIN passing game available; start both.
items.opportunity: Normal routes/targets for Olave; Burrow efficiency.

items.text: Berry agrees with deep stash of Germie Bernard (YAC fit with McCarthy) with Pittman out; also loves/grab Jonah Coleman with Harvey inactive. Confirms McConkey ACTIVE.
items.why: Pittman out opens Bernard; Harvey inactive opens Coleman; YAC/McCarthy scheme fit.
items.implication: Priority waiver/stash adds in deeper leagues for immediate opportunity.
items.opportunity: Potential target/carry share spikes for stashes.
